mapper.select: SELECT t.BID_CASE_ID, t.TASK_CD, t.SORT_NO, t.KIND_CD, t.JUDGE_CD, t.FACT_KEY, t.PRECOND_KEY, t.PREREQ_CD, t.COND_KEY, t.DONE_YN, t.DONE_BY, t.DONE_AT, t.REF_ATTACH_ID, t.REF_SHA256, t.REF_BY, t.REF_AT, d.TASK_NAME AS TASK_NAME, COALESCE(d.READY_YN, 1) AS READY_YN FROM BID_PREP_TASK t LEFT JOIN PREP_TASK_DEF d ON d.TASK_CD = t.TASK_CD ORDER BY t.BID_CASE_ID, t.SORT_NO, t.TASK_CD
SELECT a.BID_CASE_ID, a.EMP_NO, u.NAME FROM BID_ASSIGNMENT a LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.EMP_NO = a.EMP_NO WHERE a.ACTIVE_YN = 1 ORDER BY a.BID_CASE_ID, a.ASSIGNED_AT, a.EMP_NO
SELECT p.BID_CASE_ID, p.CONFIRMED_BY AS EMP_NO, u.NAME FROM BID_PREP p JOIN USERS u ON u.EMP_NO = p.CONFIRMED_BY
SELECT DISTINCT BID_CASE_ID FROM TASKS WHERE TEAM = #{team} AND STATUS = #{status} AND BID_CASE_ID IS NOT NULL
SELECT CODE, CODE_NAME FROM COMMON_CODE WHERE CODE_GROUP = #{group} AND ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY SORT_NO, CODE

SELECT c.BID_CASE_ID, c.COL_CD, c.REV_NO, c.MARK_CD, c.MARK_DATE, c.ACTOR_NAME, c.EMP_VERIFIED, c.SAVED_AT FROM BID_PREP_CHECK c JOIN (SELECT BID_CASE_ID, COL_CD, MAX(REV_NO) AS MAX_REV FROM BID_PREP_CHECK GROUP BY BID_CASE_ID, COL_CD) m ON m.BID_CASE_ID = c.BID_CASE_ID AND m.COL_CD = c.COL_CD AND m.MAX_REV = c.REV_NO

SELECT c.BID_CASE_ID, c.COL_CD, c.REV_NO, c.MARK_CD, c.MARK_DATE, c.ACTOR_NAME, c.EMP_VERIFIED, c.SAVED_AT FROM BID_PREP_CHECK c WHERE c.BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND c.COL_CD = #{colCd} AND c.REV_NO = (SELECT MAX(x.REV_NO) FROM BID_PREP_CHECK x WHERE x.BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND x.COL_CD = #{colCd})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BID_PREP_CHECK (BID_CASE_ID, COL_CD, REV_NO, MARK_CD, PREV_MARK_CD, MARK_DATE, ACTOR_EMP_NO, ACTOR_NAME, EMP_VERIFIED, SCREEN_ID, BUTTON_ID, UI_VALID, SAVED_AT) VALUES (#{bidCaseId}, #{colCd}, #{revNo}, #{markCd}, #{prevMarkCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{markDate}, #{actorEmpNo}, #{actorName}, #{empVerified}, #{screenId}, #{buttonId}, #{uiValid}, #{savedAt})
